name: thousand-refractions-prepare-1-declined-champion-stays-rested
notes: Thousand Refractions (XLbCBxla8K, LUXEM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 0, printed power 1): "Prepare 1. [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Player 2 declines Prepare 1: the champion stays rested after the attack and Thousand Refractions goes to the graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand.
